category_title: Students with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) showing variable engagement
scenario_title: Whole-class instruction in core subjects without individual support
minimal_context: The student is expected to copy and solve math problems from the board during whole-class instruction.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Class, please look at the board and copy down the math problems for today's lesson.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits at the desk looking away from the board, keeping the notebook closed and exhibiting no interaction behaviour.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Everyone should be writing the problems down now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Remains seated and does not participate in the instruction, showing signs of being inattentive.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's keep going, we only have a few minutes left to finish this.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Exhibits inattentive and misbehaving actions, completely failing to participate in the whole-class activity and showing no interaction behaviour with peers or the teacher.)
